replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heeya Sayah,

Thank you for your time creating this report!
In my eyes the player only tries to remove the obstacles in front of the wall, because he doesn't tries to burn the wall itself.
Well, I'm not entirely sure if that's the case, so I'll review the evidence with the other moderators and come back to you.

Regards Flo/resepignev

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heeya Sayah,

After reviewing the evidence, I decided to give the player the benefit of the doubt.
The player shows no interest in burning the wall, he only removes the wood in front of it.
Based on that, this report is denied.

Regards Flo/resepignev :)
